name: cin7-omni
description: Full Cin7 Omni access from Claude: contacts, products, stock, sales orders, purchase orders, quotes, credit notes, payments, adjustments, transfers, BOMs, production jobs and more — every resource the Cin7 Omni API exposes.

api_username.title: Cin7 API Username
api_username.description: The API connection username from Cin7 Omni (Settings → Integrations → API v1 → your connection). Not your Cin7 login.

api_key.title: Cin7 API Key
api_key.description: The API connection key that pairs with the username above.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When enabled, Claude can only look up data — the create/update/delete tools are not exposed at all.
